checks: Read ce4a362fe44872e9 §3. The frozen formulation abstracts the same compact continuous setting and keeps e strictly positive. It adds no claim about a density or a finite support of the starting law.

If the common positive and negative first-moment totals vanish, the law lives on the zero set of m. Otherwise their moment-weighted normalizations are probability laws on the respective open sign sets.

On an opposite-sign pair, multiplying the proposed mixing density by the x-weight or y-weight gives exactly the inverse moment of that coordinate times J. Tonelli recovers both original restrictions even when moments approach zero. This also verifies total mixing mass.

Strictly positive continuous e has a positive minimum. The ratio is therefore an expectation of component ratios under the reweighted probability measure, and it is continuous on the weakly compact centered set. An extremum forces almost every component of an extremizing mixture to attain it.
readability: The zero-moment part is used as the law of singletons, and its total mass is added after the pair construction.
